```{python}
# | echo: false
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

from _warehouse import connect

con = connect()

reservoir_projects = con.sql("""
    select
        repo.name
        , repo.created_at::date::varchar as created
        , repo.updated_at::date::varchar as updated
        , repo.description
        , repo.html_url as repository
        , repo.stargazers_count
        , repo.homepage
    from personal.tap_github.repositories as repo
    where repo.org = 'reservoir-data' and repo.name not in ('.github', 'actions')
    order by repo.name
""").df()


def render_project(project) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"### {project.name}",
        "",
        f"- Created: {project.created}",
        f"- Last updated: {project.updated}",
        f"- Description: {project.description or 'TBD'}",
        f"- Repository: [{project.repository}]({project.repository})",
        f"- Stars: {project.stargazers_count}",
    ]
    if pd.notna(project.homepage) and project.homepage:
        lines.append(f"- Homepage: [{project.homepage}]({project.homepage})")
    return "\n".join(lines)


Markdown(
    "## Data Engineering\n"
    + "\n\n".join(render_project(p) for p in reservoir_projects.itertuples())
)
```
